hub.speaker: Lupe
hub.text: Cans, caps, and good gossip. What do you need?

lore.speaker: Lupe
lore.text: Buff Kings are pressed — word is some new writer's been taking VEK's walls. Chrome Saints move through the train yard after dark, and the city's cleanup crew got fresh budget this month. Don't sleep on your best spots.

hub.speaker: Prime
hub.text: New blood with a can. I've watched writers come and go on this block for thirty years.

choices.lockedText: (Come back when you're Known on this block)

who.speaker: Prime
who.text: Darnell. They wrote PRIME. Every fill you ever bit traces back to somebody — mine traced to the ones before me. That's how style works: it's a lineage, not a costume.

lesson.speaker: Prime
lesson.text: Letters first, style second. Your throwie's E leans lazy — tighten the spine, let the bar swing. Style is a debt you pay forward to the ones who came before.

effects.message: Prime schooled you on letter structure. (+40 rep)

hub.speaker: Moth
hub.text: Eyes open. Quiet night so far.

choices.text: Why'd Ghost Line take your book?

watch.speaker: Moth
watch.text: Cameras sweep, guards loop, civilians stare too long. I count the gaps. You paint in the gaps.

book.speaker: Moth
book.text: They said I 'owed' them for painting their alley — took three years of outlines as payment. Now I watch their walls for you instead. Funny how that goes.
